websites.note: The inherited `url` field is a page the compiler used to describe a venue, NOT a verified official website. No record has been visited. `kind` distinguishes a third-party directory reference from a site that appears to belong to the venue.

kinds.directory_reference: A listing/index page hosted by a third party (city portal, studio-house directory, tourism site). Not the venue's own website.
kinds.shared_organisation_site: One URL reused by several venues because it belongs to their umbrella organisation rather than to the individual venue.
kinds.venue_site_unverified: A URL on a domain that appears to belong to the venue. NOT verified as official — no record was visited during the feasibility phase.

verification_statuses.unverified: Carried over from the inherited data. Nobody has confirmed this URL belongs to the venue, is current, or is the official site.
verification_statuses.verified_official: Confirmed by visiting, with the confirmation recorded. No record has this status yet; the vocabulary exists so it can be earned later.

venue_type.community_centre: Neighbourhood/community centre: Stadtteilzentrum, Nachbarschaftshaus, Mehrgenerationenhaus, Bürgerzentrum, Kiez-Treff, Begegnungsstätte.
venue_type.cultural_centre: Cultural centre with a public programme: Kulturhaus, Kulturzentrum, sozio-cultural centre, Freizeitforum, Gemeinschaftshaus.
venue_type.library: Public or community library, including district and central libraries.
venue_type.gallery: Exhibition space, typically municipally run: Kommunale Galerie, project space.
venue_type.event_venue: Venue whose primary function is hosting events: halls, stages, converted industrial event spaces.
venue_type.creative_hub: Multi-use creative quarter or hub combining studios, workshops and public programme space.
venue_type.makerspace: Shared making space with public access: 3D printing, textiles, electronics.
venue_type.workshop_space: Subsidised craft/art workshop with public or subsidised access.
venue_type.rehearsal_space: Rehearsal or production space for performing arts and music.
venue_type.artist_studio_building: Building let primarily as artist studios.
venue_type.coworking_space: Commercial coworking space, sometimes with public event space.
venue_type.advice_centre: Advice and counselling service for creatives or residents.
venue_type.association_office: Office of a membership association, chamber or professional body.
venue_type.portal: Online-only resource: portal, directory or information service with no public physical venue of its own.

community_relevance.public_events: Hosts events open to the general public.
community_relevance.open_access: Drop-in access without membership or appointment.
community_relevance.participatory_workshops: Runs courses, workshops or making sessions open to participation.
community_relevance.neighbourhood_gathering: Provides social space: café, lounge, meeting rooms, garden.
community_relevance.making_repair: Provides tools, materials or repair facilities.
community_relevance.arts_presentation: Presents art, performance or exhibitions to the public.
community_relevance.rehearsal_production: Provides space for producing or rehearsing work.
community_relevance.advice_support: Offers counselling, advice or support services.
community_relevance.funding_access: Provides access to grants, loans or finance.
community_relevance.private_workspace: Rents workspace privately; not public by default.
community_relevance.information_resource: Provides information online or by remote enquiry.

product_status.included: Part of the Kiez Events Atlas venue directory.
product_status.excluded: Not part of the directory; reason recorded.
product_status.pending_review: Physical venue whose community relevance is ambiguous; needs a human decision.

event_source_status.candidate: A plausible source exists but extraction is unproven or incomplete.
event_source_status.qualified: A source was fetched and yielded usable, dated events.
event_source_status.temporarily_unavailable: Source unreachable at last check (DNS, 404, outage).
event_source_status.not_suitable: The known URL publishes no usable event data.
